rows.summary: A chaos-mesh experiment ~18 minutes ago simultaneously crashed all three Kafka brokers and supporting pods, causing the Flink job to restart and halting Iceberg commits. The pipeline has fully self-recovered: Flink is RUNNING with 19 checkpoints/5 min, and lakehouse.events received a fresh commit 1.9 minutes ago.

The IcebergTableStale alert is self-resolving: the Flink job restarted ~4 minutes ago and Iceberg commits are already flowing (last commit 1.9 min ago). The outage was caused by a broad transient disruption ~18 minutes ago—likely triggered by a Chaos Mesh deployment—that simultaneously crashed Kafka brokers, the Flink job, and the ingestion service. All components have self-recovered.

IcebergTableStale was caused by a simultaneous restart of all 3 Kafka brokers ~18 min ago (exit_code 255/Unknown, likely a chaos-mesh experiment), which crashed the Flink job and halted Iceberg commits. The Flink job has since restarted and recovered — 19 checkpoints completed in the last 5 min, consumer lag 0, and lakehouse.events received a commit just 1.9 min ago. The alert should clear imminently.
